links.outcome: Readability grade level of chatbot answers, standard versus sixth-grade simplified prompt
links.effect: Standard ChatGPT-4 ARLC 12.01 and Gemini 11.25 grade level; simplified ARLC 6.73 and 6.72. Accuracy Likert stayed ~4.8-4.97 (p=0.090 between models).
links.quote: In particular, almost all readability indices suggest that standard AI chatbot responses require a higher level of education for comprehension, whereas simplified responses require a lower level of education.

links.outcome: Reading level of patient-directed chatbot responses with and without a sixth-grade instruction
links.effect: Standard responses required about grade 11-12 (ARLC 12.01 ChatGPT-4, 11.25 Gemini); simplified responses about grade 6-7 (ARLC 6.73, 6.72).
links.quote: The simplified responses provided by both AI chatbots consistently showed better readability, requiring lower education levels for full comprehension compared to their standard versions.

links.effect: Accuracy: standard p=0.557, simplified p=0.090; Gemini standard more readable by ARI p=0.014, GFOG p=0.040, FRF p=0.001; simplified only FRF p=0.016.
links.quote: Although Gemini-2.0 standard responses were more readable than ChatGPT-4 standard responses according to ARI, GFOG and FRF scores ( p = 0.014, p = 0.040, and p = 0.001) (Table 3 ), Gemini-2.0 simplified responses were more readable than ChatGPT-4 simplified responses solely according to FRF scores ( p = 0.016) (Table 4 ).

links.outcome: readability of simplified patient education answers
links.effect: Simplified ARLC reduced from 12.01 to 6.73 for ChatGPT-4 and 11.25 to 6.72 for Gemini; accuracy remained 4.97 vs 4.97 and 4.87 vs 4.83.
links.quote: The simplified responses provided by both AI chatbots consistently showed better readability, requiring lower education levels for full comprehension compared to their standard versions.

links.outcome: reading grade level of patient-facing answers
links.effect: FKGL fell from 11.08 to 5.94 for ChatGPT-4 and 10.32 to 5.95 for Gemini after sixth-grade simplification prompting.
links.quote: In terms of readability, the simplified responses produced by both AI chatbots offered a clear advantage, requiring a lower educational level for comprehension compared to their standard versions.

links.effect: Likert accuracy: ChatGPT-4 standard 4.97±0.18, simplified 4.97±0.18; Gemini standard 4.87±0.57, simplified 4.83±0.38; standard Gemini range included 2–5.
links.quote: In our study, it was showed that both AI models performed similarly in terms of accuracy, with no statistically significant differences found between their standard and simplified response formats.

links.outcome: Readability and accuracy of simplified versus standard chatbot responses
links.effect: Simplified vs standard responses reduced reading level (FKGL 5.94 ± 1.54 vs 11.08 ± 2.23 for ChatGPT-4; 5.95 ± 1.19 vs 10.32 ± 1.46 for Gemini) without significant difference in accuracy (p = 0.557, p = 0.090).
links.quote: In particular, almost all readability indices suggest that standard AI chatbot responses require a higher level of education for comprehension, whereas simplified responses require a lower level of education.
